data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, the name Ambu is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Amba’ meaning nectar or ‘Amrit’. It is believed that this name was given to the divine mother Goddess Parvati when she was blessed by Lord Shiva with the elixir of immortality. The name Ambu carries the meaning “Nectar” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ambu usually hope their child will grow to embody nectar and live with faith, good character and purpose.
